name: portal tombs

attributes.attribute: door-like stone structure built by pre-Celtic people
place where one could enter the Otherworld

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Portal tombs are a type of prehistoric monument. The entry is a cross-reference. The full account appears under DOLMEN. A portal tomb is a door-like structure of stone. Pre-Celtic people built these monuments for reasons that are not certain. Such tombs were cross points into the Otherworld. The record of portal tombs is thin, so the dolmen entry carries the detail.

okr.objective: Show portal tombs as a cross-reference to the dolmen entry.
key_results: Notes the portal tomb as a stone structure linked to the Otherworld
